dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High-intensity white pixels are concentrated in narrow, reticulated clusters forming a web-like pattern across the dorsal surface, while the lower lateral area shows dense, low-intensity pixel concentrations lacking internal variation.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most distinct closed-loop structures on the upper dorsal area form a non-equilateral triangular relationship, with the primary vertex oriented toward the cranial region.
